examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}いしやすい。
{乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}いの{薬|くすり}を{飲|の}んでおいた。
examples.english: I took motion sickness medicine in advance.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}いしないように、{窓|まど}を{開|あ}けて{新鮮|しんせん}な{空気|くうき}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I opened the window to let in fresh air so the child wouldn't get motion sickness.

notes:
A general term for sickness caused by the motion of vehicles. Covers car sickness, sea sickness, air sickness, etc. Composed of {乗|の}り{物|もの} (vehicle) + {酔|よ}い (intoxication; sickness).

SPECIFIC TYPES:
- {車酔|くるまよ}い: car sickness
- {船酔|ふなよ}い: sea sickness
- {飛行機酔|ひこうきよ}い: air sickness
- バス{酔|よ}い: bus sickness

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}いする: to get motion sickness
- {乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}いの{薬|くすり}: motion sickness medicine
- {乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}いしやすい: prone to motion sickness
- {乗|の}り{物酔|ものよ}いを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent motion sickness
